stock.description: WK Group (Holdings) Ltd functions as a specialized structural steelwork contractor, providing procurement, manufacturing, and erection services for steel components utilized in construction projects across Hong Kong. Established in 1999, the firm's principal office is located in Tsuen Wan, Hong Kong. It operates as a subsidiary of WK (BVI) Limited.
